description: This is a Java class named Node that manages a hierarchical configuration structure with key-value pairs, supporting various data types. It provides methods for property retrieval, modification, and handling nested nodes within a configuration map.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A class representing a configurable node with properties, supporting hierarchical structure and type conversions.

methods.name: Node
methods.description: Default constructor, needed for XMLEncoder serialization.

methods.name: Node
methods.description: Constructor that creates a node with a prefix, optionally initializing from a parent node.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string is numeric (can be parsed to Double).

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Returns a child node by name, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getIntProperty
methods.description: Retrieves an integer property by key, returning a default value on failure.

methods.name: getBoolProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean property by key, defaulting if not present.

methods.name: getBoolProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean property by key with a specified default value.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property with a string value.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property with an integer value.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property with a boolean value.

methods.name: setBoolProperty
methods.description: Sets a boolean property.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a string property with a default value if not present.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a string property, defaulting to empty string if not found.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix of the node.

methods.name: setPrefix
methods.description: Sets the prefix of the node.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the internal configuration map.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the internal configuration map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property with a double value.

methods.name: getDoubleProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a double property by key, returning a default value if not numeric.
